findings.evidence: No explicit adhesive tape, hook-and-loop, narrow cable-tie or heat-shrink product row found.1005005221573556 variants15/20/25mm are nylon webbing, not adhesive hook-and-loop.

findings.assessment: No need to demand GH1.25 stock again; user owns it. General Dupont leads are not by themselves a locked flight power harness. Use the explicit35V220uF XT30 selection for known nominal capacitor stock; unlabelled A/CR885 options cannot establish polarity/voltage or a specific topology. The16V3300uF receiver capacitor belongs only on a compatible low-voltage rail, never the24V tether input.
